subject: AcmeHealth - hosting constraints & evidence request (post-demo follow-up)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — hosting constraints & evidence needed

Hi Alice — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single plan: 

Summary of the call
- AcmeHealth will process PHI; primary concern is auditability, data residency, and contractual protections (BAA).
- You prefer to avoid initial on-prem installs but need assurances that Hosted mode meets your compliance bar. Dedicated capacity and a Private VPC were discussed as fallback options.
- Procurement wants a list of deliverables/evidence we can provide during vendor review.

Requested from AcmeHealth
1) Confirm preferred hosting path: Hosted API (with SOC2 + BAA) vs Dedicated (reserved GPUs) vs Private VPC/on-prem. If you could indicate primary and fallback, that helps our tech/infra sizing.
2) Confirmation of audit window: do you require access to logs for a scheduled external audit Q3 (Jul) or ad-hoc?
3) Point person in procurement for contractual timeline (cc'd or reply).

What Redwood can provide (next steps from our side)
- I will circulate our SOC2 Type II summary and a draft BAA for redlines.
- Marcus from Legal/Product will outline technical evidence (KMS/HSM support, retention/egress controls, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logs, pen test summary).
- If Hosted isn't acceptable, we will prepare a Dedicated capacity estimate and a high-level Private VPC checklist.

Proposed timeline
- Today (T+0): we share SOC2 summary + draft BAA (attached).
- T+2 business days: we provide Dedicated sizing and cost ranges if you need predictable throughput.
- T+5 business days: if you prefer Private VPC, we supply a deployment checklist and typical lead times.

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (summary), BAA_draft_AcmeHealth.docx, Deployment_Route_Options.xlsx

Action items
- Alice: confirm hosting preference (primary + backup) and audit timing.
- Procurement: confirm procurement contact and any PO/contract cadence constraints.
- Redwood (Marcus): provide technical evidence details (will follow).

Thanks — happy to jump on another 20-min call if useful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
https://www.redwoodinference.com

---

From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AcmeHealth Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — hosting constraints & evidence needed

Hi Tessa — appreciate the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 

1) Hosting preference
- Primary: Private VPC (we want network isolation into our Azure VNet and customer-managed keys).
- Fallback: Dedicated capacity hosted in Redwood's US region (if Private VPC lead time is too long).
- Hosted (shared multi-tenant) is acceptable only if Redwood can provide an explicit SOC2 Type II report plus signed BAA and technical controls demonstrating tenant isolation and per-tenant logging.

2) Audit window
- We have an external audit tentatively scheduled for 2027-09-12 to 09-16. We will need seven (7) days of access to logs and evidence prior to audit start (so deliverables by 2027-09-05 ideal).

3) Procurement contact
- Please loop in our procurement lead: procurement@acmehealth.com (I copied them here). Typical timeline: initial SOW/BAA review within 2 weeks, PO within 4-6 weeks depending on redlines.

On technical asks: please include evidence around KMS integration (Bring Your Own Key), retention controls, system and application audit logs (retention period, export format), and network segmentation diagrams for the Private VPC option. Also include any SOC2 scoping (which trust services categories are in scope).

Thanks — Alice
Alice Jones
Director of Product Security | AcmeHealth

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — hosting constraints & evidence needed

Alice — perfect, that is very helpful. Quick reply and what we'll deliver this week: 

Deliverables (we'll attach these to the HubSpot deal and Docusign as needed)
- SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (summary & auditor letter). Full report available under NDA — we can start that exchange now.
- Draft BAA_draft_AcmeHealth.docx for your legal to review. Please feel free to mark up for redlines.
- Deployment_Route_Options.xlsx (short matrix comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC including lead times, typical SLAs, expected cost delta).
- Technical evidence pack (coming from Marcus): KMS/BYOK steps, network architecture diagram for Private VPC, log retention/export examples, pen test summary.

Notes on Private VPC lead time and pre-reqs
- Private VPC (customer VNet peering or Azure ExpressRoute) typical lead time: 4–6 weeks after network approvals on your side. We need an IP range, firewall rules, and an identity provisioning plan (SAML/SCIM or service accounts).
- BYOK/KMS: we support AWS KMS & Azure Key Vault for key wrapping. For true HSM isolation, we can integrate customer-managed HSM in Dedicated/Private setups — we'll list options.

Fallback / interim option
- If audit access timing is tight, Dedicated capacity (reserved pool) gives deterministic isolation and accelerated onboarding (1–2 weeks) with a signed BAA; however, it doesn't provide your VNet-level isolation. That is usually acceptable for short-term audit evidence.

Next actions (for this week)
- T+0: I attach SOC2 summary + draft BAA + options matrix (see attachments).
- T+1: Marcus will send the technical evidence pack.
- Alice/Procurement: confirm whether we should proceed with the Private VPC kickoff (we will schedule a network intake) or, alternatively, we prepare a Dedicated SOW.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with your infra and security team this week. Which day/time works?

Thanks — attaching the files now.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, BAA_draft_AcmeHealth.docx, Deployment_Route_Options.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@acmehealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, AcmeHealth Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — hosting constraints & evidence needed

Hi Alice/Tessa — looping in Legal & Product to confirm technical evidence scope. Short checklist from our side that I'll deliver by EOD Friday: 
- Full SOC2 Type II report (NDA gated).
- Signed BAA template + redlineable Word doc.
- Network diagram for Private VPC + Azure-specific peering checklist.
- KMS/BYOK integration steps and sample configuration for Azure Key Vault.
- Log export examples (JSON/CSV) and retention options (30/90/365 days).
- Pen-test summary and remediation tracker (last pentest: 2026-11, low/med findings corrected).

One operational note: if your audit in September requires a historical export from a Hosted environment, confirm retention period expectations now — our default is 90 days for indexed logs, archive available for longer retention (we can include egress costs in the SOW).

I'll follow up with the pack and a proposed time for a technical kickoff.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference
